notes.title: Release of "Pixel Game Maker Series Werewolf Princess Kaguya", a new ActionGame!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Froir-YQP34;full][/previewyoutube]

"Pixel Game Maker Series Werewolf Princess Kaguya" is an arcade-like high tension vertical scrolling action game that can be enjoyed in 10 minutes per stage.
The game is set in the Heian period (794-1185) with a nostalgic dot style, and the player has to use the wolf and the kaguya to strategically capture the stages.

Please enjoy the game!
